title_sq: Vila Luksoze me Pishinë në Rezidencën Akacia Hills 2 për Shitje

title_en: Luxury Pool Villa in Acacia Hills 2 Residence for Sale
description_en: Luxury villa with swimming pool in the residence Akacia Hills 2, organized on four floors:- First floor: Day area with partially separated kitchen, one bedroom and one toilet.- Second floor: Three bedrooms, one with private toilet and wardrobe, and a shared toilet for the other two rooms.- Third floor: Matrimonial suite with bedroom, relaxation area, toilet and exit to the balcony.- Floor -1: Living room adapted for children's playroom, room laundry, and storage room with exit to the garage. Enclosed garage for two cars and four outside parking spaces. Spacious yard and functional pool. For more information or a visit to the property, please contact.
